meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描旧版记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、.seed.md、Claude 自带记忆),把它们搬进共享记忆文件夹,整理归类、建索引,并生成迁移报告,确保换工具后记忆不丢。
howto.when: 更新后提示共享记忆不兼容、检测到旧记忆文件,或你说“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等时触发。

say.text: 把旧版 CLAUDE.md 记忆迁移到共享记忆树
say.note: 启动迁移流程,扫描并整理旧记忆

say.text: 迁移记忆后,列出被隔离的符号链接
say.note: 报告隔离链接,供你选择保留、删除或导入
合并行为指令,不覆盖已有内容

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans legacy memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .seed.md, Claude auto-memory), moves them into the shared memory folder, organizes and indexes them, and produces a migration report, so memory survives provider switches.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, when legacy memory files are detected, or when you say "migrate memory", "legacy memory", etc.

say_en.text: Migrate my legacy CLAUDE.md memory into the shared tree.
say_en.note: Starts the migration and organizes old memories.
Shows isolated links so you can decide next steps.
Merges behavior rules without overwriting existing content.
